synthesized_findings: The parent should distribute capabilities by typed reference and compile-time normalization, not by copying upstream repo trees or collapsing packet boundaries early.
The-library supplies the right upstream mental model because it is catalog-first and agent-agnostic.
The compiled harvest should act like a governed derivative of the packet set, not a replacement for it.
doctrine_implications: Keep per-repo and per-topic packets as the durable intake boundary.
Use the compiled feature matrix and gap map as downstream views driven by those packets.
Preserve source provenance in every compiled row so a later implementation can rehydrate the upstream authority.
unresolved_ambiguities: The upstream `library.yaml` is empty by default, so the exact parent admission and sync workflow still needs later implementation.
